sites.name: Charlotte Square
sites.tagline: Live above it all. Steps from everything.
sites.description: Leasing site for a new luxury apartment building at 50 Charlotte Street in Rochester's East End. Residences and floor plans, amenities, neighborhood, tour scheduling and resident login, with the structured data, canonicals and lead-capture plumbing that make a property site rank and convert. Moving to its own domain shortly.

sites.name: Evolution24 Properties
sites.description: Corporate site for a family-owned property company: eleven buildings across Rochester, Syracuse, Manlius and Geneva, with live availability and rents from the same source the leasing team uses. Property pages for every building, an availability view, resident portal hand-off, FAQs and contact, plus the technical SEO, structured data and lead routing underneath. Moving to evolution24.net shortly.

sites.name: Round24
sites.description: The maintenance platform that measures the labor. Every hour, receipt and door reconciled automatically: Round24 turns the pay logs, rent rolls and P&L sheets a crew and office keep by hand into one connected, encrypted ledger, and gives residents a way in, so the whole building runs on one system. Built out of my own time in the field, with offline photo and receipt capture for techs with no signal in a basement. Live in beta.

sites.name: cbuy
sites.tagline: Sell anything. Get paid in crypto.
sites.description: Peer-to-peer marketplace for physical goods, settled in stablecoins. Escrow releases on carrier delivery confirmation. Encrypted messaging, image verification, an AI price checker, barter, and a crypto sticker marketplace with an AI sticker maker. One flat fee, promised never to rise.

sites.name: Faraday
sites.description: Anonymous encrypted video calling. A WebGL2 shader destroys your face and on-device DSP your voice before a byte leaves the browser. No accounts, no logs, no trackers. Relay-only TURN with ephemeral credentials, so your IP never reaches the peer. One-time fee, same code on every device.

sites.name: Glitch Pixel Studio
sites.tagline: Real-time WebGL glitch + AI camera FX.
sites.description: A real-time WebGL glitch and AI camera FX studio for Android. True CPU Asendorf pixel sort, GPU datamosh, kaleido and radial UV warps, 40+ generators, on-device MediaPipe face FX, MIDI and audio-reactive control, projector mode for VJ sets. The site itself runs a live shader kit you can play with.

sites.name: This Is An Art Gallery
sites.tagline: Anyone can hang work. Nobody signs it.
sites.description: An open, anonymous art gallery and minting platform on Base, curated in seasons by rotating directors. No artist names, no collector names: remove the name and the work has to stand on its own. Single 1/1 works with reserve auctions, a commissions program, a zine printed each season, and an open application flow.

sites.name: b0b.dev
sites.description: Independent OSINT research: sourced reporting on surveillance infrastructure and control networks, an interactive map, and open audio tools, all behind a video gate. Served with a strict content security policy and a crawler allowlist.

sites.name: irl.ing
sites.tagline: God Love merely is, and nothing else is at all.
sites.description: A single page: two lines of text over a generative canvas of rain and light. Nothing to click, nothing to buy.
